points.en: CRR is the percentage of Net Demand and Time Liabilities (NDTL) that banks must maintain as cash with the RBI.
points.hi: CRR is the percentage of Net Demand and Time Liabilities (NDTL) that banks must maintain as cash with the RBI.

points.en: It is a mandatory reserve requirement under Section 42(1) of the RBI Act, 1934.
points.hi: It is a mandatory reserve requirement under Section 42(1) of the RBI Act, 1934.

points.en: Higher CRR reduces the lendable resources of banks, thereby contracting money supply.
points.hi: Higher CRR reduces the lendable resources of banks, thereby contracting money supply.

points.en: Lower CRR increases liquidity in the banking system, encouraging credit expansion.
points.hi: Lower CRR increases liquidity in the banking system, encouraging credit expansion.

explanation.en: Cash (kept with RBI) Reserve (mandatory) Ratio (percentage of NDTL).
explanation.hi: Cash (kept with RBI) Reserve (mandatory) Ratio (percentage of NDTL).

question.en: Does the RBI pay interest on CRR balances?
question.hi: Does the RBI pay interest on CRR balances?

answer.en: No, the RBI does not pay any interest on the cash reserves maintained by banks.
answer.hi: No, the RBI does not pay any interest on the cash reserves maintained by banks.

misconception.en: CRR is kept by banks in their own vaults.
misconception.hi: CRR is kept by banks in their own vaults.

correction.en: CRR must be maintained in cash with the RBI; vault cash is part of SLR.
correction.hi: CRR must be maintained in cash with the RBI; vault cash is part of SLR.

fiveFacts.en: CRR is a tool of quantitative monetary policy.
fiveFacts.hi: CRR is a tool of quantitative monetary policy.

fiveFacts.en: It applies to all Scheduled Commercial Banks.
fiveFacts.hi: It applies to all Scheduled Commercial Banks.

fiveFacts.en: RBI has the power to fix CRR without any floor or ceiling limit.
fiveFacts.hi: RBI has the power to fix CRR without any floor or ceiling limit.

fiveFacts.en: CRR is calculated on the basis of NDTL.
fiveFacts.hi: CRR is calculated on the basis of NDTL.

fiveFacts.en: Changes in CRR directly impact the Money Multiplier.
fiveFacts.hi: Changes in CRR directly impact the Money Multiplier.

threeTraps.en: Confusing CRR with SLR (which can be in gold/securities).
threeTraps.hi: Confusing CRR with SLR (which can be in gold/securities).

threeTraps.en: Assuming CRR is a tool for fiscal policy.
threeTraps.hi: Assuming CRR is a tool for fiscal policy.

threeTraps.en: Thinking banks earn interest on CRR deposits.
threeTraps.hi: Thinking banks earn interest on CRR deposits.
